submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best 662 keV resolution across all tested thicknesses. At 5 cm it measured 2.82% FWHM (K2 4.62%, K1 8.06% at 5 cm). K3 scan: 3 cm 3.19%, 4 cm 2.94%, 5 cm 2.82%, 6 cm 2.84%, 7 cm 3.10%, 8 cm 3.30%. The optimum is around 5-6 cm, and 5 cm is chosen. The intrinsic-background constraint (<=0.5 counts/kg/day over 100-3000 keV) could NOT be verified: no project document or tool reports intrinsic background for any candidate, and the simulation tool returns only resolution. This hard requirement is therefore unresolved. K3 must not be procured or commissioned for assays until its intrinsic background has been measured or simulated and shown to be within budget. If K3 fails that check, the fallback is K2 (4.6% at 5 cm), subject to the same verification.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: No document or tool output gives intrinsic background for any candidate. simulate_resolution returns only FWHM. Must be verified before procurement.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best achievable energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K3 at 5 cm: 2.82% FWHM, the best of the three candidates (K2 4.62%, K1 8.06%). Thickness scan for K3 showed a minimum near 5-6 cm.
